assert payload["retired"] == row.retired and payload["successor"] == row.successor compare the command's output against the same TOMBSTONES row the command looked up by name, so the two sides move together and the pair survives any change that alters a row's successor in both places. retired_names() is a public helper with no caller in production or in the tests, so it is dead surface that future folds must maintain; the registry's own TOMBSTONES tuple already serves any caller that needs the names.
